paper_verdict.estimator_family: panel FMOLS (group-mean, cointegration-based) with country intercepts; no instrumental variables
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Exposures are cryptocurrency market indicators (Bitcoin/Ethereum returns and percentage change in trading volume), not technology adoption or capital stock, so units and meaning differ from adoption-based estimates. Outcome is real GDP growth (%), not a level or productivity measure. Quarterly data, 14 countries, mixed income. Table 7 reports p-values, not SEs (SEs not recoverable). N reported inconsistently (462 vs 448). FMOLS handles endogeneity and Granger tests show bidirectional BTCV-GDP, but no causal identification.
